You spend four days initially in Mykonos – which includes Day 4 (when you must attend a conference) – then fly (direct from Mykonos to Budapest) on Day 4. (Because the flight day “counts for both” cities, Day 4 is part of your Mykonos stay and also begins your Budapest visit.) You then remain in Budapest on Day 5. (That “Budapest block” now covers 2 counted days.) On Day 6 you take a flight from Budapest (direct to Hamburg) so that on Days 6–7 you are in Hamburg (2 days in total). Then on Day 8 you make a two‐leg flight (first from Hamburg to Budapest, then from Budapest to Mykonos; note that if two flights occur on the same calendar day, the layover city counts only once for that day) so that Day 8 is counted for Budapest and Mykonos. Finally, you finish your trip in Mykonos on Day 9 (which is also needed for your conference).

Counting by “city–days” (remember a flight day contributes to both the departure and arrival cities):

• Mykonos appears in an initial block from Day 1–4 (4 days) and then again from Day 8–9 (2 days), for a total of 6 days.
• Budapest appears in a short block from Day 4–5 (2 days) and then again (via the inbound flight day on Day 8) for 1 day, for a total of 3 days.
• Hamburg is “visited” on Days 6–7 (2 days).

The direct–flight network is honored because:
– You fly from Mykonos to Budapest on Day 4.
– From Budapest you fly directly to Hamburg on Day 6.
– On your return you fly from Hamburg to Budapest (and then on to Mykonos) on Day 8.
Also, your two conference days (Day 4 and Day 9) fall in Mykonos.

    {"day_range": "Day 8-9", "place": "Mykonos"}
  ]
}

Explanation of the timeline:
• Day 1–4: You are in Mykonos (Day 4 counts both for Mykonos and—for later purposes—for a flight departure).
• At the end of Day 4 you fly from Mykonos to Budapest (so Day 4 overlaps Mykonos and Budapest).
• Day 4–5: You remain in Budapest (2 counted days for Budapest so far).
• On Day 6 you fly (direct from Budapest) to Hamburg so that Days 6–7 are spent in Hamburg.
• On Day 8 you take a flight from Hamburg to Budapest and then from Budapest to Mykonos; on Day 8 Budapest is visited (adding 1 day to Budapest, for a total of 3) and Day 8 also counts in your final Mykonos block.
• Day 8–9: You are in Mykonos for your final 2 days (with Day 9 hosting your second conference).

This plan meets all the conditions:
– Total “city‐days”: Mykonos 6, Budapest 3, Hamburg 2.
– Conference requirements on Day 4 and Day 9.
– Only direct flights are used (Mykonos↔Budapest and Hamburg↔Budapest).
